notFound.description: Reba ihuza, cyangwa ufungure isuzuma uhereye ku rutonde rw'isuzuma.

denied.body: Iri suzuma ni iry'ikigo kiri hanze y'uburenganzira bwawe bw'ubu. Iki gikorwa cyanditswe mu bubiko bw'ibikorwa.

flag.label: Byagaragajwe ngo bisuzumwe
flag.heading: Impamvu iri suzuma ryagaragajwe

summary.DEMO_BP_SYSTOLIC_AT_OR_ABOVE_THRESHOLD: Umuvuduko wo hejuru ugeze cyangwa urenze urugero rw'igerageza rwashyizwe mu mategeko {{version}}.
summary.DEMO_BP_DIASTOLIC_AT_OR_ABOVE_THRESHOLD: Umuvuduko wo hasi ugeze cyangwa urenze urugero rw'igerageza rwashyizwe mu mategeko {{version}}.
summary.DEMO_GLUCOSE_AT_OR_ABOVE_THRESHOLD: Isukari mu maraso igeze cyangwa irenze urugero rw'igerageza rujyanye n'igihe yapimiwe, rwashyizwe mu mategeko {{version}}.
summary.GLUCOSE_UNIT_MISSING: Igipimo cy'isukari cyanditswe nta gipimo-shingiro, bityo amategeko {{version}} ntiyagisuzumye — umuntu agomba kukireba.
summary.GLUCOSE_CONTEXT_NOT_RECORDED: Ntibyanditswe niba yariye; amategeko {{version}} yakoresheje agaciro k'agateganyo k'igihe kitazwi.
summary.notEvaluable: Amakuru akenewe ntiyuzuye, bityo amategeko {{version}} ntiyasuzumye iri pimwa — ryoherejwe ku muntu.

flag.disclaimer: Kugaragaza ni ubutumwa bwo gusaba umuganga gusuzuma — si isuzumabumenyi ry'indwara.

rulesetModal.title: Amategeko y'igerageza {{version}}
rulesetModal.description: Amategeko y'urugero agaragaza ipimwa muri iri gerageza. Agaciro kayo ni ak'agateganyo — ntikemejwe mu buvuzi kandi nta rwego rw'ubuvuzi rwakemeje.
rulesetModal.unknown: Iyi verisiyo y'amategeko ntiboneka muri iri gerageza, bityo amategeko yayo ntashobora kugaragazwa.

rules.BP-1: Umuvuduko wo hejuru ugereranywa n'urugero rw'igerageza rw'umuvuduko wo hejuru.
rules.BP-2: Umuvuduko wo hasi ugereranywa n'urugero rw'igerageza rw'umuvuduko wo hasi.
rules.GLU-1: Isukari mu maraso (ihinduwe muri mmol/L) igereranywa n'urugero rw'igerageza rujyanye n'igihe yapimiwe.
rules.GLU-2: Igipimo cy'isukari gikenera igipimo-shingiro; kitagifite ntigisuzumwa kandi cyoherezwa ku muntu.
rules.GLU-3: Bikwiye kwandikwa niba yariye; bitanditswe, hakoreshwa agaciro k'agateganyo k'igihe kitazwi.

evidence.title: Ibimenyetso
evidence.subtitle: Amakuru uko yafashwe igihe byagaragazwaga, agereranyijwe n'amategeko y'igerageza {{version}}.
evidence.caption: Amakuru y'ibimenyetso n'imimerere yayo ku mategeko y'igerageza
evidence.noRule: Nta tegeko ry'igerageza risuzuma aya makuru
evidence.amendedAfterFlag: Ibimenyetso byakosowe nyuma yo kugaragazwa — reba amateka y'ikosora
evidence.amendedAfterFlagBody: Ipimwa ryakosowe nyuma y'uko rigaragajwe. Ibimenyetso biri hejuru ni ibyafashwe igihe ryagaragazwaga kandi ntibihinduka.
evidence.empty: Nta bimenyetso byafashwe — ntibishobora gusuzumwa; vugana n'abashinzwe ubwiza bw'amakuru

howToRead.title: Uko wabisoma
howToRead.body: Kugaragaza ni ubutumwa busaba umuganga kureba iri pimwa. Si isuzumabumenyi ry'indwara kandi ntigutegeka umuti. Amategeko y'igerageza akoresha agaciro k'agateganyo katemejwe mu buvuzi — koresha ubushishozi bwawe bw'ubuvuzi n'amakuru yose.

prior.title: Amateka y'ipimwa
prior.subtitle: Ipimwa 5 riheruka ry'uyu murwayi
prior.caption: Ipimwa 5 riheruka, irya vuba mbere
prior.empty: Nta ipimwa ryanditswe kuri uyu murwayi.

responsibility.title: Ushinzwe isuzuma
responsibility.reassignNote: Guhindura ushinzwe isuzuma ntibishoboka muri iri gerageza.

outcome.title: Umusaruro
outcome.body: Iri suzuma ryarafunzwe kandi rirasomwa gusa.

actions.takeOverDescription: {{name}} ari gusuzuma iki kibazo. Gufata isuzuma byandikwa mu mateka y'ibikorwa hamwe n'impamvu yawe.
actions.readOnlyCoordinator: Ibyemezo bifatwa n'umuganga cyangwa umusuzumyi wabiherewe uburenganzira
actions.offline: Interineti yigana yavuyeho — isuzuma ntirishobora gutangira ubu
actions.startedBody: Ubu ni wowe usuzuma iki kibazo.

conflict.title: Undi muganga yahinduye iri suzuma
conflict.description: Nta cyasibwe. Fungura verisiyo iheruka mbere yo gukomeza.
